[b]Tactics[/b]

There was much hustle and bustle in the government of Thýven as the invitation to a special summit in Kingsmount was thrown back at them. Of course it provided eager expansionists the opportunity to see potential economic exploits, and political theorists the opportunity to study the full nature of the Albic government.

However, despite the hubbub and madness that stoked the government of Thýven, the crown remained firm, it would attend the meeting and summit with one goal, the goal to ensure a proper power-bloc was formed in order to provide for the common defense. Or as Mij Drs put it frequently [i]Fíjr Pjolés[/i] (For the People). 

Preparations were thus made on Thývens side for the 81-year old monarch to make an appearance as the head of the delegation, both as a show of the supremacy of the ancient monarchy and as a show of Adní given monarchical authority with which the Albic peoples had long abandoned. 

The delegation would arrive in Kingsmount via a simple unmarked white plane, of which the only manner by which might tell that it carried precious treasure aboard was by radio comms. The plane was intentionally chosen as an austerity tactic, perhaps to signify the austerity of the Thýven government against the seemingly bloated Albic government, which is what many in Thýven viewed Albany as, blþa.

March 17, 2025

In the early hours of the morning, a small fleet of the Etherniasti Maritime Guard (EMG) successfully intercepted and engaged a [nation]Sal-Baliz[/nation] vessel suspected of illicit activities in contested waters. The operation, which began as a covert surveillance mission, escalated when the target vessel became aware of our presence and opened fire on our forces without provocation.

For four intense hours, the Etherniasti fleet engaged in a tactical naval battle, utilizing superior maneuvering and firepower to subdue the hostile ship. Despite the unexpected aggression, our highly trained personnel maintained discipline and strategic coordination, leading to a decisive victory.

Following the engagement, the Sal Baliz vessel was disabled and secured. Our forces took five prisoners, who are currently being transported to Etherniasti under high-security protocols for interrogation and legal processing. No Etherniasti personnel sustained critical injuries, and our fleet remains fully operational.

The government of Etherniasti reaffirms its commitment to maritime security, ensuring that our waters remain safe from hostile threats. Further diplomatic actions regarding this act of aggression will be discussed with our allies and relevant international bodies.

The Etherniasti Maritime Guard stands vigilant, ready to protect the sovereignty of our nation. More updates will follow as the situation develops.

For Etherniasti, for security, for the future.

Admiral Kaelen Durnhardt
Supreme Naval Command
Etherniasti Maritime Guard

"Try to send a communication to them. Tell them code black."
